Job description:
Job Description: Design and implementation of AI-based solutions for process automation, building Chatbots and intelligent assistants for customer response, using AI for processing shipping documents (Invoice, Packing List, BL, etc.), connecting AI tools to CRM, email, and internal systems, designing intelligent Agents to perform repetitive tasks, data analysis and providing intelligent reports, training and optimizing the use of AI in various departments of the company. Requirements: Familiarity with ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and other language models, experience working with AI APIs, familiarity with Python is considered an advantage, familiarity with Automation Tools like n8n, Make, or Zapier, ability to analyze business processes and provide solutions, learning and problem-solving mindset. Benefits: Negotiable and competitive salary, career growth opportunities, collaboration in innovative projects, dynamic work environment.

Company description:
Rahyab Bariar Sana company, with a brilliant history in the field of international transportation, is the provider of the most complete forwarding and logistics services. This company, relying on its extensive network, provides reliable, fast, and cost-effective solutions for its customers worldwide in the fields of land, air, and sea transportation.
